name: issue_m0
instructions: Which specific issue is this customer message about? Pick the single closest issue.
state_template:
Customer message to a digital bank's support chat:
{{input}}

criteria.activate_card: Activating a new card, whether it needs activation
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet / where is my card
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery dates, tracking, delivery abroad
criteria.card_linking: Adding / linking a card to the app, card showing up in the app, re-adding a found card
criteria.card_not_working: Card stopped working in general (not a specific declined payment)
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept / swallowed / took my card
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring, replacing an expiring card
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional or second card, cards for family members
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards (how many, how many uses)
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual or disposable card rejected / not working

visa_or_mastercard.description: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing one
examples: I have a Visa and Mastercard, can I use these?

card_acceptance.description: Where the card is accepted, which ATMs / merchants accept it
examples: You accepts my card?

atm_support.description: Which ATMs can be used, ATM support in general
examples: Am I limited to what ATM I can use my card?

change_pin.description: Changing or updating the card PIN
examples: In regards to the PIN of the card?

pin_blocked.description: PIN blocked / locked after wrong attempts, PIN not working
examples: My PIN can't access my card, can you help?.

apple_pay_google_pay.description: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch, including topping up with them
examples: Does my top up and apple pay work together?

declined_card_payment.description: A card payment / purchase was declined or rejected
examples: I know there's money in my account, why did my account decline me?

declined_cash_withdrawal.description: ATM cash withdrawal was declined, could not get cash
examples: The ATM didnt let me get cash

pending_card_payment.description: A card payment is still pending
examples: I've made a card payment a couple of days ago now but it looks like the money is stuck. How long does it typically take?

pending_cash_withdrawal.description: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending / not showing
examples: I took out money from the ATM and it's still showing as pending?

lost_or_stolen_card.description: Card lost or stolen, reporting it, replacing it
examples: I need to report a stolen card

compromised_card.description: Card details or PIN compromised, someone else has used my card
examples: I think my pin has been compromised, what do I do?

card_payment_not_recognised.description: A card payment I don't recognise / didn't make
examples: I would like to dispute a payment I didnt make

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.description: A cash withdrawal I didn't make
examples: Why is there a cash withdrawal I didn't make?

criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit I don't recognise

unrecognised_money_in_account.description: Unexplained money or activity in my account that I didn't put there or don't recognise
examples: there is money in my account that i didnt put there

lost_or_stolen_phone.description: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere; using the app without my phone
examples: I am not sure where my phone is.
phone is at a hotel, can i still use app

passcode_forgotten.description: Forgot app passcode, cannot log in with passcode, new passcode
examples: I can't get into the app with the passcode.

request_refund.description: Asking for a refund from a merchant / for a purchase, cancelling a purchase or an order, goods not received
examples: Can you please help me in canceling my order.

criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund has not appeared yet

charged_twice.description: Duplicate charge, charged twice for the same payment
examples: My card was declined but it shows as multiple charges?

extra_charge_on_statement.description: Unexplained extra or small charge on my statement (e.g. a pending 1 pound charge)
examples: Why is there an extra charge on my statement.
There is a pending 1£ charge on my statement.  I haven't purchased anything for 1£.  Why is it on my statement?

wrong_amount_of_cash.description: ATM gave less cash than requested
examples: I was not distributed the correct amount of cash that I asked for

reverted_card_payment.description: A card payment was reverted / cancelled / returned
examples: What does it mean if my payment has been reverted?
My payment was terminated

card_payment_fee.description: Fee charged for paying by card
examples: I have been charged an extra fee when buying from your store. Why is this?
Im not sure why Im being charged an extra fee just for purchasing an item from another country?

cash_withdrawal_charge.description: Fee charged for ATM cash withdrawal, withdrawal fees
examples: Please help!  There was an extra fee when I got cash.

criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set, what the rate is
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_card: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_cash: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
criteria.top_up_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card

top_up_bank_transfer_charge.description: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
examples: Will there be a charge for topping up by account with a SEPA transfer?
There is a fee for a transfer, please explain that to me.
I made a transfer and the receiver said an amount was received, but less than the right amount. I now have to transfer more money.

fiat_currency_support.description: Which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged
examples: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding and exchanging?

supported_cards_currencies.description: Which card types or brands (credit cards, American Express, international cards) and currencies are supported or accepted, including for top-ups
examples: Can I use American Express?
What options do I have when topping up a US card?

top_up_methods.description: Ways and places to top up / add money in general (not Apple Pay / Google Pay, which are their own issue)
examples: What apps can I use to top up my account?

criteria.top_up_by_card: How to top up using a card (the process), card top-up not working
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque

top_up_reverted.description: Top-up reverted / money disappeared after top-up
examples: My money disappeared! Please help??

verify_top_up.description: Top-up verification code, why verify a top-up
examples: Where is the top-up verification code?

criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after cheque or cash deposit
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add or send to a beneficiary

cancel_transfer.description: Cancelling a transfer, sent a transfer to the wrong account
examples: I don't need to transfer anymore and I want to cancel it.
One of my transactions needs to be canceled.
I did a money transaction and dont have a receipt
What is the length of a transaction completion?
I recently purchased something and the seller says my money has not arrived yet. It was in EU's. How long does this take

transfer_into_account.description: How to transfer money into my account
examples: Can a credit card be used to transfer money?

account_security.description: How safe my money / account is, what security protects my funds
examples: What kind of security protects my money?

criteria.age_limit: Age requirement to open an account

country_support.description: Which countries the service is available in, using it abroad / all over the world, signing up from a given country
examples: How do I sign up for a card if I'm in America?
Can I use this all over the world?

verify_identity.description: How to verify identity, which documents are needed
examples: do I need to verify my identity before I can use my card?
help me find where this money came from
